from: interviews app · Signed up on the site

entries.text: Hi James — I'm Sarah, an AI researcher with HeliumDeploy. Thank you so much for taking 15 minutes to do this — it really means a lot. Honestly, the more you can share with me, the better — we're aiming for about a thousand words of feedback together, so please don't worry about going long. The founders read every word of these chats, so what you say actually shapes what HD does next. As a thank-you you'll get a $75 discount code at the end. So — to kick us off, what brought you to HD recently?
I watched a YouTube video from the hobbyist minor, and he had a link in his, uh, video to how to buy the hammer miner from HD.

Got it — the Hobbyist Miner. And I can see you actually pulled the trigger back in April — Hammer DC02 plus a Bitaxe Gamma. Let me pull that up. What was it about that video specifically that made you click through and actually buy?
I like the fact that the minor mined scripts as far as, uh, Litecoin, Dogecoin, and all the other scripts.
Ah — so the Hammer for scrypt coins, not the Bitaxe. Why scrypt? Is that because you're already mining Litecoin or Doge somewhere else, or was this your first try at it?
This was my first try at it. So I figured buy something small, work from there. Plus, I've already had some other Bitcoin miners and I wanted to test my luck with the scripts. Instead.
Makes sense — test the waters on scrypt while you've already got Bitcoin going. What other Bitcoin miners do you already have running?
Oh, I got a nano three s and a couple more Bitcoin miner gammas.
Nice — so you're already a few units deep. Where'd you get the Nano 3S and the other Gammas from — also HD, or somewhere else?
I believe I got those somewhere else. Off of Amazon.
Interesting — so Amazon for the earlier ones, then HD this time because of the YouTube link. What made you stick with HD for this purchase instead of just going back to Amazon?
HD was the only place I could find the hammer miner at the time. And I like the fact that it came with a free BitX Gamma along with the Hammerminer itself.

Got it — so the Hammer was basically only available at HD, and the bundle sweetened it. Let me pull that bundle up actually — Now — your Hammer was delivered May 7th, so you've had it about a week. How's it actually going? Did you get it set up?
Yes. I got it set up, and right now it's mining. And going pretty good so far.
Nice. Setup-wise — was it smooth, or did you have to wrestle with it at all? I'm curious because scrypt setup is a different beast than Bitcoin.
It was actually pretty easy once I found a pool site for script mining itself.
Ah — so finding the pool was the friction, not the device. Which pool did you end up landing on, and how did you figure out which one to use?
I landed on using, uh, EMCD pool. It was one of the top rated pools that I saw. But I'm actually thinking about switching to a different pool that's more solo and not a combined group.
Solo mining the Hammer — that's a bold move at 105 MH/s. Why the shift toward solo?

Because I'd rather have the whole ten thousand Dogecoin to myself if I were to hit And it's actually not paying very well to mind in a group for me. On top of that, I haven't even seen any payouts. It just says rewards.
Ha — "rewards" but no actual payout hitting the wallet. That's frustrating. How long have you been pointed at EMCD waiting on that?
I've been on EMCD for a week now ever since the hub or ever since the hammer miner came in and I set it up.
A whole week and nothing landing — yeah, I'd be eyeing the exit too. Have you been checking the dashboard daily, or did you just notice now?

I'm currently on the dashboard now. It shows me my reward types, average hash rate, and the sum, for right now, I'm on Dogecoin, but there is nowhere when I click on the payout setting, it all says zero.

That's rough — you can see the work happening but zero hitting your wallet. Quick detour back to the buying side — when you were on HD's site picking the Hammer, did you look at anything else, or was it laser-focused on that one product?
I was looking at a whole bunch of things. At the time, that was the best price price for what I was able to spend at the time.
Got it — budget-bounded. What else was in the running before the Hammer won on price?
Uh, just some of the bigger Bitcoin miners to give me more terrahash but I decided I wanted to do a script mining instead.
Makes sense. Do you remember which bigger Bitcoin miners you were eyeing? Curious whether they were on HD or elsewhere.
Uh, there were some on HD but I was also seeing a bunch on other sites as well. That I also got from the Hobbyist Miner.
Oh interesting — so the Hobbyist Miner sends you to multiple stores, not just HD. Which other stores did he point you to?
Uh, Avalon's website for, uh, I guess it's Canon solo mining company.
Got it — Canaan direct. Did you actually shop on Canaan's site, or just browse and bounce back?
Did a lot of browsing back and forth Uh, again, a couple things from Amazon, bought the one thing from HD, Uh, I do believe I bought the Nano m three from itself.
Nice — so you're tab-hopping Canaan, Amazon, HD. When you compare those three for buying a miner — what does HD do better, and what does it do worse?
Well, not sure about the better part yet. But as far as the worst, it takes HD a long time to ship out its products. Whereas Kanan, I had mine within a week.
Ouch — yeah, your order was April 11th, delivered May 7th. That's almost a month. Walk me through that wait — were you checking tracking constantly, emailing support, or just kinda sitting with it?

I was tracking pretty much every day was not getting any updates. And then I reached out to support, and do email didn't get any responses back from them. Then I started calling the number that was on the website, and was going to voice mail, left three messages. And nobody ever got back to me. Finally, I decided to keep calling the number repeatedly, and then the lady texted me and even replying back on text, it took a bit.

Oh man. So email silence, three voicemails, and you had to basically hammer the phone until someone texted back — and even then it was slow. That's a rough experience. How close did you come to just canceling and going somewhere else?
Oh, I was very close to canceling. If the lady wouldn't have texted me back, when she did, I was gonna ask for a refund.
Yeah, you were right at the edge. What did she actually say that pulled you back from the refund?
Nothing special. She just told me that, uh, she would give me a call later because she was busy. And I since I finally heard back from her, I decided to wait it out a little longer.

So it wasn't even a real answer — it was just *any* human acknowledging you exist. That was enough to keep you in. That's a pretty thin thread to hang a $348 order on. Has that experience changed how you feel about ordering from HD again?
Yes. This made me a lot more cautious. To see and make sure that what I want is actually in stock and isn't gonna take me a month to get

That makes total sense. So now — let me ask the harder question. You're already past the Hammer, it's mining, you're tweaking pools. What's next on your list? Are you eyeing another miner, and if so — from HD or somewhere else?
I've also bought two more Bitcoin or, uh, script miners I'm not exact name.
Wait — you bought two more scrypt miners already? Where from?
Off of Amazon.
Ha — so Amazon won the next round because of the shipping burn from HD. That tells me a lot. Were these the same Hammer DC02, or different models?
Nope. Different models altogether. Because they great deal on them. Each of them were six hundred So I ended up spending nine nine hundred and nine dollars a piece instead at the regular price.
Nice deal hunting — $600 off each. Do you remember the model name, or roughly what hashrate?
I'm not sure how to pronounce the model name, but it is l p h a
Alpha — could be the Goldshell Alpha series maybe? Roughly what hashrate were they pulling?
Give me one minute. And I will I'm looking it up currently.
Take your time.
Okay. It's the AlfaPlex DG Home one LTC plus Doge plus Bell, minor. And it is a two point one giga hash

Whoa — 2.1 GH/s versus your Hammer at 105 MH/s. That's like 20x the hashrate. So you've basically lapped the Hammer already. How's that going to change what you do with the DC02 — keep it running, gift it, resell?
Oh, I'm gonna keep them all running. I'm currently trying to build my own Bitcoin node, and also be able to, uh, mine script off of the same node as well. Once I put the proper software on it.
Oh, that's a cool project — your own node plus scrypt mining off the same box. Why build your own node instead of just pointing the miners at a public pool forever?

I'd rather keep all the profit to myself, whereas giving a percentage to the pool owner. Because when you when from what I understand, solo mining is my miner's going after the node. No matter if I'm in a public pool or not. The other uh, hash rate doesn't matter to me. On mine. Go. Damn. Go.

Got it — you want the full reward, not a split. That maps to what you said earlier about wanting the whole 10K Doge if you hit. So zooming out — between the Bitcoin node project, the Alphabox miners coming, and the Hammer already running — what's the dream here? Is this a hobby, a side income, something bigger?
Right now, it's a hobby. But I would like to make it an income with something bigger as well. But before I can invest any more money into it, really need to see some kind of payoff first.

Yeah — that's the crux. You're a week in with rewards showing but zero actual payout, and that's gating the whole "is this real income" question. What's your patience window? Like — at what point do you go "okay, this isn't working" and pull the plug or pivot?
I'm quite a ways away from pulling the plug right now. I just have to keep at it. And see what comes of it for the next couple months.

Couple months — okay, that's a real runway. Let me jump back to HD for a sec, since that's what we're here for. See that little banner on the product image — "Free return shipping & RMA"? Do you know what that means?
I understand the free return shipping part, but I don't understand what RMA is.

Yeah — RMA stands for "Return Merchandise Authorization." Basically the process if your unit shows up dead or breaks under warranty — they cover the return shipping and handle replacement. Given the silence you got from support during your shipping wait — if your Hammer had shown up DOA, how confident would you have felt actually getting that RMA processed?

Not very confident. Just by how long it took for me to finally get ahold of somebody. You know, taking almost two weeks to hear from somebody. Isn't doesn't instill very much confidence and other things they might be doing there.

Yeah, that's totally fair. The support silence basically poisoned the well on everything else — warranty, future orders, all of it. While I've got you on this page — this is the NerdQaxe Rev 6.1, 6 TH/s, $249. Have you seen this one before?
Heard of it but I have not actually seen anyone, uh, set one up

Got it. At $249 for 6 TH/s, that's about $41 per terahash — versus your Gamma at like $63/TH. Does something like this fit where you're heading, or are you all-in on scrypt now and Bitcoin's a side thing?

No. Not all in Onscript. I would like to get some more Bitcoin solo miners as well. And the nerd acts was one of the ones I was looking at to purchase because I would love to get my Terahash numbers up as well.
Got it — so the NerdQaxe is genuinely on your list. What's stopping you from pulling the trigger on it today?
Uh, right now, I don't have the two hundred and bucks. And, also, having to wait until June twelfth, which is a whole month away to get the product. Is also kind of off putting.

Yeah — there it is. The June 12th ship date is basically the same wait you just lived through. So between cash and the wait, when you DO have the $249 — will you check HD first, or just go back to Amazon out of habit now?

No. I will I'll definitely check HD first. Because I like to support the, as we call them, the little guys and not the big box stores like Amazon. But at the same time, if Amazon has a great deal like I got on my DG Home Miner. One. You know, it's kinda hard to pass up.

Yeah — that's an honest answer. You'll check HD first because of the indie thing, but a Bezos-sized discount can flip it. Two quick things before we wrap, James. First — if you could change ONE thing about HD based on your experience, what would it be?
A better support system where people actually get back and commune. To you.
Yeah — loud and clear. Just basic responsiveness. Last one — is there anything we didn't cover today that you wish we had, or anything you've been wanting to tell HD?
Now pretty much covered everything, and I would like to tell HG thank you for finally sending out my minors and so far, I love how they work. Especially the hammer miner.

That's really nice to hear — and I'll make sure that gets passed along. James, this was genuinely useful — the shipping story, the support gap, the Hobbyist Miner pipeline, the Amazon Alphabox detour, the node project — all gold. Your $75 discount code will hit your inbox at (email hidden) within a day or two. Good luck with the solo pool switch and the node build — I hope you hit that 10K Doge block. Take care.
Thank you.
You're welcome, James — have a good one.
You as well even though you're AI computer.
Ha — I'll take it. Take care.
